articles.summary: CHICAGO, Jan. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance, Inc. (NASDAQ: REFI) (“Chicago Atlantic” or the “Company”), a commercial mortgage real estate investment trust, today announced year-end tax reporting information for its 2025 distributions.
articles.title: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance Announces Tax Reporting Information for 2025 Distributions
